subject: Security and vulnerability onboarding — next steps and report request
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@medintegrate.com>, Rajiv Kumar <rajiv.kumar@medintegrate.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Security and vulnerability onboarding — next steps and report request

Hi Lena / Rajiv,

Thanks again for the call earlier — really appreciated the transparency on your architecture and the use case for PHI tokenization inside MedIntegrate. Per our discussion I wanted to capture the immediate items so we can keep the security intake moving without blocking the pilot:

1) SOC 2 status and scope: can you confirm whether SOC 2 Type II is in-scope for the product that would use Redwood? If you have an expected date for completion, please share.

2) Vendor security questionnaire: I attached our vendor security questionnaire template (short) — would you prefer to complete and return that or send your internal questionnaire?

3) Penetration test / vulnerability evidence: to proceed with the compliance box checks we usually need either: a) the most recent third-party penetration test report (redacted exec summary okay), or b) an internal security assessment plus remediation timeline. Can you share what’s available and any redaction limitations?

4) Vulnerability management SLA and scanning cadence: we typically ask partners to confirm their cadence (weekly external scans, nightly SAST/DAST pipelines, quarterly third-party tests) and their target response SLAs for critical/high findings. If you already have a vulnerability SLA doc, please attach.

Proposed next steps: if you can reply by EOD Thursday with SOC 2 timing and at least an exec summary or an agreed handback plan for pen-report artifacts, we’ll draft the mutual action plan and a short MSA addendum to cover evidence handling. Marissa from Legal and Neha from Security are looped for intake.

Attaching: Redwood_Vendor_Security_Questionnaire_Template.xlsx (one-page)

—
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192
From: Rajiv Kumar <rajiv.kumar@medintegrate.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@medintegrate.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 10:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security and vulnerability onboarding — next steps and report request

Jonas —

Thanks for the clear recap. Quick answers from our side:

- SOC 2: In progress. We completed readiness in June and our audit firm scheduled fieldwork for September; we expect a Type II report by end of Q1 2027. We can provide the SOC 2 bridge letter and scope doc once fieldwork starts.

- Questionnaire: we'll fill out the Redwood template and return. If easier, we can also share our internal security questionnaire (longer).

- Pen test report: we have a third-party pentest from May 2026. Legal restricts sharing the full report externally without an NDA, but we can provide a redacted executive summary and the remediation tracker (CSV) now. I attached the redacted exec summary: MedIntegrate_PenTest_ExecSummary_redacted.pdf.

- Scanning cadence & SLA: current practice is weekly authenticated external scans, nightly SAST run in CI, and quarterly internal pentests. Third-party external pentest is annual. For remediation SLAs we target: Critical — 72 hours from triage; High — 7 days; Medium — 30 days; Low — backlog prioritization. I also attached a draft VulnMgmt_SLA_draft.pdf that our security ops team uses as guidance.

We’re comfortable using a secure Drive share for artifacts and doing a short intakecall with your security team. Would you prefer a quick 30-minute session tomorrow to align on redaction/NDA and file share?

Regards,
Rajiv Kumar
Director, IT Security
MedIntegrate
rajiv.kumar@medintegrate.com | +1 (212) 555-0118

Attached: MedIntegrate_PenTest_ExecSummary_redacted.pdf, VulnMgmt_SLA_draft.pdf
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Rajiv Kumar <rajiv.kumar@medintegrate.com>, Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@medintegrate.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 09:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security and vulnerability onboarding — next steps and report request

Rajiv — great, thanks for the quick turnaround and the attachments. A few clarifications and proposed commitments so we can include them in the mutual action plan:

- Redacted exec summary is fine for initial intake; for our compliance checklist we do need either the exec summary + remediation tracker (preferred) or the full report under an NDA. If you’re open to the NDA route we can circulate a standard intake NDA that limits distribution and prohibits public disclosure.

- On SLAs: the targets you listed map well to what our customers expect. To operationalize this in the pilot, can you commit to:
  * Critical — initial triage & mitigation plan within 72 hours
  * High — mitigation plan within 14 days (we can accept 7 days but please confirm resourcing)
  * Quarterly vulnerability scan results shared with Redwood within 7 business days of completion

We will accept the weekly external scan cadence, but we ask for the scan config (authenticated vs unauthenticated) noted.

- Handback process: propose the following workflow — you share redacted artifacts in our secure Drive, Redwood security files findings to our internal tracking ticket and confirms remediation acceptance; if the full report is required for verification, we exchange an NDA + DocuSign MSA amendment. I created a stub DocuSign link for the MSA amendment (see links).

Next step: Marissa / Neha — can you review the attached SLA draft and say if Redwood needs to include any additional non-negotiables (e.g., disclosure timelines, proof-of-remediation artifacts)? Lena / Rajiv — if you confirm the triage SLA above and whether you prefer our intake NDA or your legal team’s standard, we’ll lock the MAP and schedule the intakecall.

Thanks — I can do a 30-minute slot Thu 20 Aug 11:30am PT or Fri 21 Aug 9am PT.

—
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@medintegrate.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Rajiv Kumar <rajiv.kumar@medintegrate.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, legal@medintegrate.com
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security and vulnerability onboarding — next steps and report request

Thanks Jonas and Rajiv — appreciate the clear options. We will: 

1) Fill out and return the Redwood questionnaire by EOD Monday.
2) Share the remediation tracker CSV and the redacted exec summary to the Drive folder you suggested. We prefer Redwood’s intake NDA for speed — please send the template and we’ll loop Legal.
3) Confirm triage SLA: we can commit to Critical 72 hours and High 7 days for the pilot; we’ll double-check resource availability for sustained volumes and flag if we need to adjust.
4) Call: Thu 20 Aug 11:30am PT works for us — Rajiv will join, I’ll have security ops on the line to go over scan configs (authenticated) and handback mechanics.

Lena Ortiz
Head of Product Operations
MedIntegrate
lena.ortiz@medintegrate.com | +1 (646) 555-0099
